name: Sola – Solastranden
notes: Long sand beach by Stavanger airport; waves in westerlies, flatter in southerlies. Popular with local schools. Also: Hellestø just south (beach break, rocks at the ends).

name: Borestranda
notes: Long open Jæren beach, waves; one of the most used kite beaches in Rogaland. Also: Orrestranda just south (nature reserve rules on the dunes).

name: Brusand
notes: Long sandy beach in south Jæren; waves, best in W–S winds.

name: Lista
notes: Windy Lista peninsula near Vanse: shallow bays and beaches for many wind directions, waves on the exposed side. Bird reserves nearby.
